Root cause. In the staged vulnerable source `CDF_DEBUG` makes `DPRINTF` a live `printf` call, but this format uses `%s` instead of a precision-bounded specifier, so the declared property length `l` is ignored and the print treats `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf` as an unbounded C string. The fix changes this to `%.*s` and passes `(int)l` as the bound.

ASan sink. The active debug print passes raw SummaryInformation property bytes to `%s`, so `printf` reads past the 253-byte payload and continues through the 8704-byte heap-backed stream buffer until it reaches the redzone.
